SKILL.md: description: Use to keep a workspace's books in oryh — 建科目表、记账（发票、收付款、工资、月末凭证）、冲销错账、月末结账、看试算平衡表、科目明细账和往来余额 — applying the workspace's own posting rules; the server only keeps the book balanced and closed months shut. Requires ledger.post (reading needs ledger.read; closing a month needs period.close).

把三月的销售发票记账
那张凭证科目用错了，改一下
给我看一季度的试算平衡表
